name: sg-cubit
summary: Full-bleed hero running shader.gallery's cubit: a field of isometric cubes rising and falling like a block city, three shaded faces meeting at crisp seams with a dark groove between every cell.

colors.description: Cube tones. The shader mixes index 3 toward index 0 per cube and lifts the result toward index 2; index 1 is read by the CSS resting state only. Omit to read --fx-c1 through --fx-c4 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one palette.

cells.description: Cubes across the frame; lower is a bolder, blockier grid. Upstream default, range 3 to 24.

rise.description: How far each cube rises and falls, which reads as brightness because taller blocks catch more light. Upstream default, range 0 to 1.

speed.description: Rate the cubes rise and fall; 0 holds the grid still. Upstream default, range 0 to 2.

contrast.description: Shading spread between the three visible faces; 0 flattens the cubes into plain hexagons. Upstream default, range 0 to 1.

deviations.what: The four u_palette tones are ours, not upstream's `nocturne` preset.
deviations.why: cubit/meta.json names a palette as a string only; the table it resolves against lives in @shader-gallery/runtime, a package paw-fx does not vendor. Ours is a night-city blue with a cyan lift, chosen to match the CSS resting state, which reads the same --fx-c1..--fx-c4.

deviations.what: No post chain: upstream's poster runs grain 0.04, vignette 0.34, contrast 1.06 and saturation 1.05 over the shader output.
deviations.why: The post chain is also in @shader-gallery/runtime. Our output is the raw shader, so it will not match the upstream poster. The section's own vignette and grain layers stand in for the parts that matter to a hero.

deviations.what: Rendered through paw-fx's own WebGL runtime (effects/_shared/glsl-mount.js) rather than @shader-gallery/runtime.
deviations.why: Seam. Upstream ships the .frag with no module around it. The GLSL itself is byte-identical to upstream and lives in shader.frag beside index.js.
